picks.title: Amazon’s shopping agent now takes orders by text, with Sponsored Product ads in the replies
picks.rationale: New ad placement: Amazon is putting Sponsored Products ads inside its text-based shopping-agent conversations, free to advertisers for now, which opens agent chat as retail-media inventory.
picks.excerpt: Sponsored Products ads are set to appear inside those conversations, free to advertisers for the time being.

picks.title: OpenAI Updates ChatGPT Ads Bidding Options
picks.rationale: Actionable buying change: OpenAI emailed advertisers that ChatGPT Ads bidding options change on November 9, affecting Max Bid and Max CPC campaigns that buyers must review before Monday.
picks.excerpt: OpenAI emailed ChatGPT Ads advertisers that bidding options change on Monday, November 9, affecting campaigns using Max Bid or Max CPC.

picks.title: Google Ads Expands AI Content Label Disclosure To California, South Korea & Vietnam
picks.rationale: Compliance change for ad creative: advertisers must now declare AI use in ads served in California, South Korea and Vietnam, adding to the EU, India and New York.
picks.excerpt: Google Ads has expanded the regions where you must disclose whether AI was used in your ads. Google added California, South Korea, and Vietnam to the list, which already included the European Union, India, and New York.

picks.title: Google Brings UCP Direct Checkout To AI Mode In Canada
picks.rationale: First market expansion of UCP-powered agentic checkout outside the US, into AI Mode and the Gemini app for Canadian shoppers, with a Merchant Center integration slated for next year.
picks.excerpt: Google is expanding UCP-powered direct checkout in AI Mode and the Gemini app to Canadian shoppers, with a Merchant Center integration planned for next year.

picks.title: Bot protection blocks Blend's AI shopping agent at 29 of 200 retailers
picks.rationale: New audit of 200 retailers: bot protection turned away Blend's AI shopping agent at 29 stores (20% of large retailers vs 2.5% of emerging ones) even where robots.txt allows AI crawlers, so merchants should check their WAF settings before agentic holiday traffic.
picks.excerpt: Large retailers refused the agent at a 20% rate, emerging ones at 2.5%, yet all 24 refusers with readable robots.txt allow AI crawlers. Who set those blocks?

https://digiday.com/media-buying/amazons.new_action: Amazon launched text ordering in its shopping agent and announced Sponsored Products ads inside agent conversations (new ad placement; the 11-03 card was only a usage figure).

https://www.searchenginejournal.com/goog.new_action: Google released UCP direct checkout in AI Mode and the Gemini app for Canada, its first market outside the US.
